about: The painted maps the Mirefen tavern wears: the Fenrire (moss) look of the painted Tidehold town, the look the painted Fenbridge buildings beside it wear. tex/ holds the Fenrire maps (the ClaudeCraft Studio repository's scripts/assets/blender_tidehold/town_tex_painted_var/fenrire/ maps): the limewash (TownPlaster), the dressed stone (TownDressed) and the garnet cloth (TownCloth) unchanged; the mossy rubble (TownStone), the weathered oak (TownTimber) and the mossy fish-scale slates (TownRoof) lifted by regrade_map.mjs's fenrire gains (their own colours scaled in linear light, brushwork kept) so that under the tavern's tints and shading they draw as Fenbridge's buildings draw them; and the boards (TownFloor) regraded by its floor ramp to a weathered brown, so the fires' warm light over them reads warm, never orange. The normal maps are the Fenrire set's, unchanged. Every map tiles seamlessly: its wrap is no sharper, nor any stronger in tone, than the lines inside it. yards is the town kit's repeat (bl_town_lib.py K) at the scale Fenbridge stands its inn (1.2), so the stones, the slates, the grain and the limewash read at the size the town's own buildings show them (the boards and the cloth, indoors, keep the kit's); normalStrength is the kit's normal strength, baked into the shipped normal map; roughness is the painted buildings' own. headroom: a painted face's colour (its tint over the map and the warm light baked over that) is stored divided by it, so the light can lift the paint up to that many times the map before the colour clamps; build.mjs writes the linear factor that undoes it (vertexColourScale, 1 / srgbToLinear(1 / headroom)) into each painted material's extras, and the runtime multiplies the colour by it. tavern_texture.py lays them on in Blender, build.mjs embeds them at each texture tier. TavernProps is the props' atlas (props/build_atlas.mjs): the painted maps of the real models dressing the room (the trophies, the shelves, the barrels, the chandelier, the candles, the banners and the rest made with Tripo, shields from the game's armoury), each in its own 512 tile; its faces carry their own UVs into it, so it has no repeat, and its scale ([across, down]) sizes it at twice each tier's colour size across and five times down (2048 by 5120 at the full tier) so every piece keeps its tile's detail.
